correctness.rationale: Parseval gives X_n=n^2+2 E_n for normalized Haar arc measure. Diagonal i=j contributes n(n-1)/2, while each off-diagonal torus character has negative endpoints i,i+d+k and positive multiset {i+d,i+k}; its only collision swaps d and k. Distinct characters have multiplicities 1 (d=k) or 2, with conjugate partners. Orthogonality gives Var(E)=2T-N1, with T=n(n-1)(n-2)/3 and N1=n(n-2)/2 for even n or (n-1)^2/2 for odd n. Independent exact exponent-vector enumeration for n=2..16 reproduced Var(X) and endpoint n=2=0. The counting argument, not enumeration, proves all n.
